Jac native standard library, support runtime and generated browser prelude:
https://github.com/jaseci-labs/jaseci/blob/main/LICENSE
The compiler version is pinned in build-lock.json.

LLVM compiler-rt notice: copied unchanged from the Jac 0.39.0 compiler
distribution, jaclang/compiler/backends/native/compiler_rt/LICENSE.txt.

zlib notice: copied unchanged from the Jac 0.39.0 distribution's
python/licenses/zlib/LICENSE. Jac links zlib for native gzip and CRC32.

Both notices also match the pinned Jac 0.39.1 distribution unchanged.
Windows builds apply scripts/prepare_jac.jac's checksum-guarded native regex
runtime patch, replacing POSIX sched_yield with Kernel32 SwitchToThread.

Native shared-library licences are collected from the pinned vcpkg checkout.
The uv release and certifi CA bundle carry their own provenance and licences.
